_comment: Derived from sts-6core-strict-5routes-budget10.json (2026-10-09). Three changes, all deliberate: (1) --route-archetypes adds the archetype axis (card_mechanics.py:136-149) so the 5 prescribed routes become 5 DIFFERENT builds instead of the 1/2/8 + 4/6 take-log duplicates the single-objective ranking produced; (2) --route-strict replaces --strict-then-search, so the run ends after its own 5 per-route evaluations (search.py:751, :762) with no failure-directed main search to muddy the comparison; (3) --budget-scale=8 with --task-seconds=720 in step, because a scaled combat clock past the per-evaluation wall cap buys nothing (search.py:322).
resource_note: 6-core strict-only run, 5 archetype routes, 8x combat solver clocks; CPUs 2,4,6,8,10,12, 6 workers x dop 1, 1 GiB per worker
